narrative_engine.thesis: trend down context (H4 stack down · D1 stack down · EMA spread -4.35 ATR · price holds below Day VWAP) set the SHORT bias. Price pulled back into the confluence zone 0.6191-0.6241 (VWAP band · POC · EMA pocket · PDH/PDL flip), where the footprint printed its confirmation. Risk is defined beyond 0.6273; the first objective pays 1.21R at 0.6157.

plan.triggerRule: footprint trap fired sell in short direction at the zone (absorption inside the zone)
plan.invalidation: structure beyond 0.6273 (signal zone / ±2σ VWAP / 0.5 ATR buffer)

athena_oracle.verdict: Strong bearish confluence 29/100 — trend broken, liq magnets below, whales offering

factors.name: Liquidation Gravity
factors.detail: long liq $289k -2.5% below · short liq $49k +2.9% above
